criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Per frame 8, 5, 7, 7, 7.5, 6.5, 6.5, 6.5, 7. Slide 1 strongest, slide 5 delivers the turn, slide 2 weakest as a flat card, slide 6 showed four stakes, slide 8's leaves bleed off, slide 7 reads as a chart panel, slide 4 plastic, slide 9 a good kit courthouse.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight Caprock world, one key, the accent meaning planned. The two reliefs sit outside the filmstrip.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Typed copy strong and the drawn square and nested ratio measured true. Held down by slide 6 drawing four stakes for 50 MW and slide 5's headline dropping up to.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the gating condition land. The deciding body and date are not stated.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and the turn is at 5. Slides 4 and 7 both make the substation point.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, attribution heavy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New subject and unit. The third lastLight deck in a row and several familiar moves.

hard_fails: Slide 6 showed 4 stakes for a 50 MW phase against its own key of 10 MW a stake, so the drawing said 40 MW.
one_sentence_fix: Re-render slide 6 so all five stakes fall inside the frame, and add a gate that counts data-in-art objects in frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat beige card with almost no relief.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A grazing key and a raised plateau casting onto the neighbours, crop so it bleeds three edges.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Four of five stakes in frame, flat flags, a faint substation.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Shift the row so all five project in frame, tied tape flagging, the pool on the yard.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A doubled centre post and leaves bleeding off.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so both leaves end on hinge posts, one latch seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A corrugated chart panel with post-cast streaks.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower key furrows, ground past every edge, clean casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Plastic fins and bushings, a faint far fence.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Weathered galvanized fins, porcelain sheds, the pool on the far fence.
